### tool/vocabulary/corpus-define/d02/answers/weighbridge-ticket.txt ### Ticket
Page
  Nav
    Brand "Scalehouse" icon="scale"
    Row gap=4
      Link "Weigh desk" onTap={go weigh-desk}
      Link "Day log" onTap={go day-log}
    Button "Print" icon="print" onTap={toast "Sent to printer"}
  Section narrow
    Card gap=16
      Row between middle
        Heading "Weighbridge ticket" level=2
        Badge.primary "{last(tickets).code}"
      Divider
      Grid cols=2 gap=12
        Column gap=2
          Text.caption "Plate"
          Text.strong "{last(tickets).plate}"
        Column gap=2
          Text.caption "Product"
          Text.strong "{last(tickets).product}"
        Column gap=2
          Text.caption "Date"
          Text.strong "{formatDate(today(),"MMM d, yyyy")}"
        Column gap=2
          Text.caption "Price per tonne"
          Text.strong "{money(last(tickets).price,"$",2)}"
      Box fill=#FF111827 radius=8 pad=16 center
        Text.caption "NET" color=#FFD1D5DB
        Text "{fixed(last(tickets).net,0)} kg" size=48 weight=700 color=#FFFFFFFF
      Row between
        Text.strong "Amount due"
        Text.strong "{money(last(tickets).total,"$",2)}"
      Divider
      Barcode "{last(tickets).code}"
  Section tint compact
    Grid cols=3 gap=16
      Card gap=4
        Text.caption "Tickets today"
        Text.strong "{length(tickets)}" size=32
      Card gap=4
        Text.caption "Total net"
        Text.strong "{fixed(sum(tickets,t=>t.net)/1000,2)} t" size=32
      Card gap=4
        Text.caption "Day's total"
        Text.strong "{money(sum(tickets,t=>t.total),"$",2)}" size=32
  Footer
    Text.muted "Scalehouse weighbridge ticket desk"

### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/neighbour-noticeboard.txt ### Post detail
state reply=""
state thread=[{"who":"Dev R.","text":"Saw a grey cat by the bins on Alder 3 this morning, will check again at lunch.","when":"1h ago"},{"who":"Maren K.","text":"Thank you! Biscuit is shy, call softly.","when":"1h ago"},{"who":"Lucia P.","text":"Posted it on the school gate group too.","when":"40m ago"}]
state at=0
state reason=""
state detail=""
Page
  Nav sticky
    Brand "Lamppost" icon="light"

            Column
              Text.strong "Maren K."
              Text.caption "Alder Street · 0.4 km away"
          Text "Slipped out near Alder Street on Sunday evening. Wearing a green collar with a bell. Very friendly but nervous around dogs. Microchipped. Please message me rather than chase her."
          Row gap=8 scroll
            Image "https://images.example.com/biscuit-1.jpg" w=160 h=120 radius=8 onTap={at=0; open shots}
            Image "https://images.example.com/biscuit-2.jpg" w=160 h=120 radius=8 onTap={at=1; open shots}
            Image "https://images.example.com/biscuit-3.jpg" w=160 h=120 radius=8 onTap={at=2; open shots}
          Row gap=8
            Button "Call Maren" icon="call" onTap={link tel:+441632960123}
            Button.outline "Share" icon="share" onTap={copy "https://lamppost.example/p/p1"; toast "Link copied"}
            Button.ghost "Report" icon="flag" onTap={open report}
        Card gap=12
          Heading "Replies ({length(thread)})" level=3
          each r in thread
            Row gap=12 top
              Avatar "{r.who}" size=32
              Column grow
                Row between
                  Text.strong "{r.who}"
                  Text.caption "{r.when}"
                Text "{r.text}"
          Divider
          Row gap=8
            Input "Write a reply" @reply grow
            Button "Send" icon="send" onTap={reply!="" ? {thread=append(thread, {"who":"You","text":reply,"when":"now"}); reply=""; toast "Reply sent"} : toast "Write something first"}
      Column w=320 gap=16 sticky
        Card gap=8
          Heading "Where" level=3
          Map lat=51.5 lng=-0.12 zoom=15 h=180 pin="Last seen near Alder St"
          Text.caption "Pin shows the area, not the exact address."
        Card gap=8 fill=#FFE8F5E9

            IconTile "health_and_safety"
            Heading "Safe meeting tip" level=3
          Text.muted "Meet in a public, well lit spot such as the corner shop or the library steps. Bring a friend after dark, and never send money before you see the item."
  Lightbox#shots photos=["https://images.example.com/biscuit-1.jpg","https://images.example.com/biscuit-2.jpg","https://images.example.com/biscuit-3.jpg"] @at
  Dialog#report "Report this notice" "Tell the moderators what is wrong"
    Select "Reason" @reason items=["Spam","Unsafe request","Wrong category","Offensive","Other"]
    Input "Details" @detail multiline
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Send report" onTap={emit report {reason: reason, detail: detail}; toast "Thanks, a moderator will look at it"; close}
### docs/reference/notation/lists.md block 4
state orders=[{"name":"Ada","total":3}]
Page
  Section
    Table o in orders columns=["Name",{"key":"total","label":"Total","align":"end"}]
### docs/reference/notation/lists.md block 10
state orders=[{"id":"o1","name":"Ada Byron","status":"Paid","total":30},{"id":"o2","name":"Lin Chen","status":"Due","total":12}]
state search=""
state status="All"
state sortKey="name"
state chosen=[]
state shown:list={filter(orders, r => (status == 'All' || r.status == status) && contains(lower(r.name), lower(search)))}
Page
  Section
    Row gap=8
      Input "" "Search" @search w=280
      Select @status items=["All","Paid","Due"] w=140
    Table#orders o in shown columns=[{"key":"name","label":"Customer"},{"key":"status","label":"Status","w":120},{"key":"total","label":"Total","w":100,"align":"end"}] sort=@sortKey select=@chosen empty="No orders match."
      Row gap=10
        Avatar "AB" size=28
        Text.strong "{o.name}"
      Badge "{o.status}"
